page_text_ocr_zh:
很久很久以前，
人们总是忘记自己出生在哪一年，
也算不清自己究竟多少岁。

爷爷，
您今年几岁了？

嗯，我想想啊……
不记得了呀！
page_text_en:
Long, long ago,
people always forgot which year they were born,
and couldn't figure out exactly how old they were.

Grandpa,
how old are you this year?

Hmm, let me think... I can't remember!
summary_zh: 本页描绘了很久以前人们记不清自己年龄的场景，一个小男孩问爷爷年龄，爷爷表示记不清，引出故事背景。

消息公布以后，所有的

哄地讨论渡河比赛的事。
page_text_en: After the news was announced, all the animals were very excited. They chattered noisily, discussing the river-crossing race.
summary_zh: 消息公布后，动物们兴奋地聚集在一起，热闹地讨论即将举行的渡河比赛。

title_en: The Story of the Twelve Chinese Zodiacs
source_file: 十二生肖的故事（3-7 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
当时，老鼠和猫是很好的朋友，
他们聚在一起讨论。老鼠说：“我们不会游泳，要怎么渡河呢？”
猫说：“可以跟牛合作，我们帮他指路，他载我们渡河。”

猫和老鼠去找牛，
牛立刻答应了。
page_text_en:
At that time, the mouse and the cat were good friends.
They gathered together to discuss. The mouse said, "We can't swim, how will we cross the river?"
The cat said, "We can cooperate with the ox. We'll guide him, and he'll carry us across the river."

The cat and the mouse went to find the ox,
and the ox immediately agreed.
summary_zh: 老鼠和猫因不会游泳而担忧渡河比赛，决定与牛合作，由牛载他们过河，牛也立刻答应了他们的请求。

title_en: The Story of the Twelve Chinese Zodiacs
source_file: 十二生肖的故事（3-7 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
到了比赛当天，一大早，公鸡还没睡醒，牛、猫和老鼠就已经来到了河边。

牛蹲下来，让猫和老鼠爬上他的背，然后开始渡河。猫平常就爱打瞌睡，今天又起得太早，很快就趴在牛背上睡着了。
page_text_en:
On the day of the race, early in the morning, before the rooster had even woken up, the ox, the cat, and the mouse had already arrived at the riverbank.

The ox crouched down, letting the cat and the mouse climb onto his back, and then began to cross the river. The cat usually loved to doze off, and since today he had gotten up too early, he quickly fell asleep on the ox's back.
summary_zh: 比赛当天，牛、猫和老鼠早早来到河边，牛驮着猫和老鼠渡河，猫因起得太早很快在牛背上睡着了。

title_en: The Story of the Twelve Chinese Zodiacs
source_file: 十二生肖的故事（3-7 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
老鼠很想得第一名，就在牛
快要抵达河岸的时候，他突然
把猫推下水，然后钻进了牛耳朵里。
牛并不知道发生了什么事，只
听到老鼠在他耳朵里喊着：“牛
大哥，加油！我们快到了。”
page_text_en:
The mouse really wanted to come in first. Just as the ox was about to reach the riverbank, he suddenly pushed the cat into the water and then squeezed into the ox's ear.
The ox didn't know what had happened, he only heard the mouse shouting in his ear: "Brother Ox, keep going! We're almost there!"
summary_zh: 在渡河比赛接近终点时，老鼠为了争第一，将猫推入水中，并钻进牛耳朵里，牛对此毫不知情，只听到老鼠在耳边喊加油。

title_en: The Story of the Twelve Chinese Zodiacs
source_file: 十二生肖的故事（3-7 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
牛爬上河岸，高兴地冲向终点。老鼠突然从牛耳朵里跳出来，抢先抵达终点，得了第一名。
牛辛苦了半天，只得了第二名，非常生气，从此就一直瞪着大眼睛。
page_text_en:
The ox climbed onto the riverbank, happily rushing toward the finish line. The mouse suddenly jumped out of the ox's ear, reached the finish line first, and won first place.
The ox had worked hard all along, only to come in second place. He became very angry and ever since, has kept his eyes wide open.
summary_zh: 牛冲向终点时，老鼠从牛耳朵里跳出来抢先到达，获得第一名；牛因辛苦却只得第二名而生气，从此一直瞪着大眼睛。

title_en: The Story of the Twelve Chinese Zodiacs
source_file: 十二生肖的故事（3-7 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
过了一会儿，全身湿淋淋的老虎来了，他很自信地吼着：“我是第一名吧！”玉皇大帝说：“不！你是第三名。

突然间，天空卷起一阵狂风，龙从天而降，眼看就要抵达终点，兔子冲了过来，抢先得了第四名。

兔子不会游泳，一路跳呀跳，踩着别人的背渡过的河。
page_text_en:
After a while, the wet tiger arrived, confidently roaring, "Am I first place?" The Jade Emperor said, "No! You are third place.

Suddenly, a strong wind blew from the sky, and the dragon descended from above. Just as it was about to reach the finish line, the rabbit rushed over and took fourth place.

The rabbit couldn't swim, so it hopped along, stepping on others' backs to cross the river.
summary_zh: 老虎到达终点后自认为是第一名，但玉皇大帝宣布其为第三名；随后龙从天而降，兔子趁机抢先获得第四名；兔子因不会游泳，靠踩着其他动物的背渡河。

title_en: The Story of the Twelve Chinese Zodiacs
source_file: 十二生肖的故事（3-7 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
玉皇大帝问龙：“你是飞来的，怎么这么晚才到呢？”原来，龙去了南海主持下雨典礼，赶回来时已经来不及了。
闪电！
page_text_en:
The Jade Emperor asked the Dragon: "You came flying, why are you so late?" It turned out the Dragon had gone to the South Sea to preside over the rain ceremony and couldn't return in time.
Lightning!
summary_zh: 玉皇大帝询问迟到的龙，得知其因主持南海下雨典礼而未能及时赶到比赛终点。

title_en: The Story of the Twelve Chinese Zodiacs
source_file: 十二生肖的故事（3-7 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
马蹄声传来，尘土飞满天。
马跑在最前面，正要冲向终点，
蛇突然从草丛里钻出来，抢先
得了第六名。
蛇本来有脚，这次跑得太卖力，
把脚都跑断了。
马本来很勇敢，这次被蛇吓着
了，从此变得很胆小。
page_text_en:
Hoofbeats came, dust flying into the sky.
Horse was running in the front, about to rush to the finish line,
when Snake suddenly emerged from the grass, and took the sixth place.
Snake originally had legs, but this time ran too hard,
and broke all its legs.
Horse was originally very brave, but this time was scared by Snake,
and from then on became very timid.
summary_zh: 马在冲刺终点时，蛇突然从草丛中钻出抢先获得第六名；蛇因跑得太猛而断了脚，马则因受惊而变得胆小。

title_en: The Story of the Twelve Chinese Zodiacs
source_file: 十二生肖的故事（3-7 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
羊、猴和鸡在河边捡到一根木头，大家通力合作，分别得了第八、第九、第十名。

羊坐在前面指路，因为看得太用力，变成了大近视眼。猴子在木头上坐得太久，屁股又红又肿。鸡本来有四只脚，上岸的时候给压断了两只，所以现在只剩下两只脚。

狗来了。他很贪玩儿，渡河的时候，居然泡在河里玩水，耽误了时间。

恭喜，你得了第十一名。
page_text_en:
Sheep, monkey, and rooster found a log by the river. They worked together and got eighth, ninth, and tenth place respectively.

The sheep sat in front to guide the way. Because he looked too hard, he became nearsighted. The monkey sat on the log for too long, so his bottom became red and swollen. The rooster originally had four legs, but two were crushed when he got ashore, so now he only has two legs left.

The dog arrived. He was very playful and, while crossing the river, actually played in the water, which delayed him.

Congratulations, you got eleventh place.
summary_zh: 羊、猴、鸡合作用木头渡河，分别获得第八、九、十名，因渡河过程产生身体变化；狗因贪玩在河中玩水而迟到，获得第十一名。

title_en: The Story of the Twelve Chinese Zodiacs
source_file: 十二生肖的故事（3-7 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
十二生肖只剩下一个名额了，
大家都伸长脖子望着前方。

猜来了，他满头大汗，喘着气说：
“饿死我了，这里有没有好吃的东西？”
page_text_en:
Only one spot remained for the Twelve Animal Signs.
Everyone stretched their necks, looking forward.

Here comes the last one, sweating profusely, panting and saying:
"I'm starving! Is there anything good to eat here?"
summary_zh: 十二生肖只剩下最后一个名额，大家翘首以盼，最后一只动物（猪）满头大汗地赶到，询问是否有食物。

title_en: The Story of the Twelve Chinese Zodiacs
source_file: 十二生肖的故事（3-7 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，湿淋淋的猫来了，
他问：“我是第几名？”
玉皇大帝说：“第十三名。”
猫非常生气，每根胡须都翘
了起来，他说：“可恶的老鼠！
我绝不饶你！”
说完，挥爪向老鼠扑过去。
老鼠吓得吱吱叫，往玉皇大帝的椅子下钻，还是被猫打了一巴掌，牙齿都被打掉了。
page_text_en:
At this moment, the wet cat arrived.
He asked, "What place am I?"
The Jade Emperor said, "Thirteenth place."
The cat was very angry; every whisker stood up.
He said, "You despicable mouse!
I won't forgive you!"
He then swung his paw and lunged at the mouse.
The mouse squeaked in fear, scrambling under the Jade Emperor's chair, but was still hit by the cat.
His teeth were knocked out.
summary_zh: 湿淋淋的猫赶到终点，询问自己的名次，玉皇大帝宣布其为第十三名，猫因此愤怒地扑向老鼠，老鼠躲藏不及被猫打掉牙齿。

title_en: The Story of the Twelve Chinese Zodiacs
source_file: 十二生肖的故事（3-7 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 老鼠虽然得了第一名，但从此每天都提心吊胆的，怕猫找他报仇。直到今天，老鼠一看到猫的影子，就没命地跑，连大白天也躲在洞里不敢出来。
page_text_en: The mouse, although it came in first place, has since lived in constant fear, afraid that the cat would seek revenge. Even today, as soon as the mouse sees the cat's shadow, it runs for its life, hiding in its hole even during the daytime.
summary_zh: 本页解释了老鼠因在生肖比赛中得第一而被猫记恨，从此胆小怕事，一见猫影就逃跑，连白天也躲进洞里不敢出来。
